Name: Survival Valley
Author: war77
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790269046-1119370720.png[/img]

[size=4][i]Turn Stardew Valley into a deeper survival and life-simulation experience.[/i][/size][/center]

Survival Valley expands Stardew Valley with a collection of interconnected survival, health, progression, equipment, and immersion systems.

Instead of simply watching your Energy bar, your farmer now has to think about food, water, body temperature, hygiene, bathroom needs, carried weight, equipment condition, food freshness, physical fitness, and more.

The goal is not to turn Stardew Valley into an impossibly punishing survival game. Most major systems can be adjusted or disabled individually through Generic Mod Config Menu, allowing you to use only the features you enjoy.

Survival Valley also includes several systems that originally existed as separate mods, bringing them together into one larger survival overhaul.


[size=5][b]FEATURES[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Hunger, calories, and realistic metabolism[/*]
[*]Water and hydration[/*]
[*]Pee and Poo bathroom needs[/*]
[*]Peep and Pewp emergency relief items[/*]
[*]Hygiene and the Stinky system[/*]
[*]Temperature, weather, clothing, and body heat[/*]
[*]UV exposure, sunburn, and sunscreen[/*]
[*]Nutrition-based food buffs and debuffs[/*]
[*]Food healing and the Overheal system[/*]
[*]Bandages and survival medical items[/*]
[*]Running, Energy costs, and exhaustion[/*]
[*]Realistic item weight and encumbrance[/*]
[*]A craftable pullable Wagon with storage[/*]
[*]Swimming and wet clothing[/*]
[*]Muscle growth, exercise equipment, and physical strength[/*]
[*]Food freshness and spoilage[/*]
[*]Equipment, weapon, clothing, and torch durability[/*]
[*]Field repairs, repair kits, and the Repair skill[/*]
[*]Nine new Survival Skills[/*]
[*]Starmastery item progression[/*]
[*]Pathfinder ground wear and natural trails[/*]
[*]Starbling decoration-based friendship bonuses[/*]
[*]Sickness, constipation, and digestive effects[/*]
[*]Overnight metabolism and extended late-night gameplay[/*]
[*]Modded food support[/*]
[*]Extensive GMCM customization[/*]
[/list]

[img width=862]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790484417-666762049.png[/img]

Survival Valley replaces simple hunger with a calorie-based metabolism system.

Food adds calories to your body while walking, running, fighting, using tools, swimming, pulling heavy loads, and simply existing throughout the day gradually burns them.

Being underfed can eventually cause survival penalties, while overeating can also have consequences. Calories continue to matter while you sleep, so going to bed does not completely freeze your metabolism.

The system is designed around long-term energy management rather than forcing the player to constantly eat every few minutes.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[b][size=5][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790485752-66407852.png[/img][/size][/b]

Your farmer now has a Water meter which gradually drains throughout the day.

Walking, physical activity, weather, heat, caffeine, and other survival systems can increase how quickly you become dehydrated.

Drinks restore Water, with Survival Valley recognizing both vanilla drinks and many modded drinks automatically.

Hydration can be absorbed gradually or restored immediately depending on your GMCM settings.

You can even drink from your Watering Can, although untreated water may come with risks.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790486830-1950076857.png[/img]

Eating and drinking now creates bathroom needs.

Pee can build up to 100, while Poo can build much higher depending on what your farmer eats. Ignoring these meters for too long can result in discomfort, accidents, stink, and other consequences.

Bathrooms, toilets, public facilities, and emergency relief items give you ways to deal with these needs.

Different foods also affect digestion differently, meaning nutrition and bathroom needs are connected rather than being completely separate systems.

[size=5][b]PEEP & PEWP[/b][/size]

When a toilet is nowhere nearby, you can craft emergency outdoor relief items.

[b]Peep[/b] is used to relieve the Pee meter.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790482412-901838688.png[/img]

[b]Pewp[/b] is used to relieve the Poo meter.

Both have their own Survival Skills which improve as you use them.

Higher Peep skill increases relief speed and changes the range and visual behavior of the Peep stream.

Higher Pewp skill increases relief speed and can increase the number of Poo items produced.

Using Pewp while beginning with at least 50 Poo can produce a usable Poo item after fully relieving yourself. This Poo can be applied to a growing crop to advance it by one growth stage.

Outdoor relief also makes the farmer dirtier, but increasing your Peep or Pewp skill reduces the amount of Stinky buildup caused by the action.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[b][size=5][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790487524-614710718.png[/img][/size][/b]

Survival Valley keeps track of your farmer's cleanliness.

Working out, bathroom accidents, relieving yourself outdoors, and other messy activities can increase your Stinky meter.

Being dirty can cause visual effects around the player and may affect social interactions with nearby villagers.

Showers provide the most reliable way to completely clean yourself.

Rain and water can clean some types of grime, while quickly splashing yourself at a shoreline can temporarily cover up your smell.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790488351-647387152.png[/img]

Your farmer now reacts to environmental temperature.

Weather, season, location, clothing, swimming, and other environmental conditions can all influence how warm or cold you are.

Clothing can provide real temperature protection, giving shirts, pants, hats, and footwear another practical purpose.

Extreme temperatures can apply penalties and, if enabled, can eventually damage your health.

The entire Temperature system, its damage, and its HUD display can be adjusted independently.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790488731-458924930.png[/img]

Sunny days now carry another risk: UV exposure.

Spending too much time outside under strong sunlight gradually increases your exposure and can result in sunburn.

Sunburn can increase Water consumption, affect Energy, and eventually damage health depending on your settings.

Sunscreen can be purchased and applied for temporary UV protection, with its strength and duration configurable through GMCM.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790488936-1523508262.png[/img]

Food is more than calories.

Survival Valley estimates nutritional properties for vanilla foods and many modded foods, including:

[list]
[*]Protein[/*]
[*]Fiber[/*]
[*]Calcium[/*]
[*]Sugar[/*]
[*]Fat[/*]
[*]Caffeine[/*]
[*]Vitamin C[/*]
[/list]
These nutrients can create temporary effects.

Protein can improve combat performance, Fiber can affect metabolism and digestion, Calcium can improve resistance to damage, Sugar can create a Sugar Rush followed by a crash, and Caffeine can increase movement speed while also making survival needs more demanding.

Nutrition effects appear as Survival Valley buff icons with information about their current bonuses and remaining duration.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790698815-1837812168.png[/img]

Food no longer needs to restore all of its health instantly.

Healing can instead be placed into the red [b]Overheal[/b] meter and gradually restored over time.

This makes recovering from injuries feel more like an ongoing process instead of instantly erasing combat damage with a single meal.

Survival Valley also includes medical items such as the Grass Bandage.

A [b]Grass Bandage[/b] can be crafted using:

[b]2 Fiber + 1 Sap[/b]

Using one places 10 HP into your Overheal meter, allowing that health to recover gradually.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790491585-1246159281.png[/img]

Physical activity can now consume additional Energy.

Walking, running, swimming, tools, carrying heavy loads, and other strenuous activities can contribute to fatigue.

Running can be toggled using the controller or keyboard and provides faster movement at the cost of greater exertion.

If your Energy reaches zero, your farmer can become exhausted and temporarily sit down while recovering enough strength to continue.

Late-night activity is especially tiring, making staying awake through the night possible but increasingly demanding.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790530045-4452924.png[/img]

Inventory items now have estimated physical weight.

Survival Valley displays item and stack weight directly in your inventory and calculates your total carried load.

Light loads have little effect, while heavier inventories gradually reduce movement speed and increase the physical cost of travel.

At extremely high weight, your farmer may be unable to move until something is dropped or stored.

Weight can be displayed in pounds or kilograms and can be heavily customized through GMCM.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790539131-251095078.png[/img]

To help manage heavy loads, Survival Valley adds a craftable pullable Wagon.

The Wagon provides two rows of portable storage and can follow behind the farmer while traveling.

The contents of the Wagon do not count directly as normal backpack weight, but pulling a heavily loaded Wagon requires additional effort.

Wagon weight can affect movement and Energy usage, while a stronger farmer is able to handle the burden more efficiently.

You can park it, access its storage, pull it through the world, and even sit on it to rest.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790539101-1027518577.png[/img]

Many natural bodies of water can now be entered.

Stand at the shoreline and choose [b]Jump In[/b] to begin swimming.

Swimming consumes Energy as you move and can affect body temperature.

When you climb back onto land, your clothes remain wet for a while. Wet clothing becomes heavier and visually darker until it gradually dries.

You can also choose [b]Splash Yourself[/b] at the water's edge for a quick temporary wash without fully entering the water.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790539168-948849796.png[/img]

Physical activity gradually builds Muscle.

Combat, tool use, fishing, and other strenuous actions can contribute to your Muscle meter.

Muscle can improve combat damage and increase the effectiveness of tools such as axes and pickaxes.

Once you become strong enough, Survival Valley unlocks exercise equipment including:

[list]
[*]Dumbbells[/*]
[*]Bench Press[/*]
[*]Butterfly Press[/*]
[/list]
Exercise equipment provides a faster way to train Muscle, but it consumes Energy and makes the farmer sweaty and Stinky.

You can also use the dedicated Flex command while facing villagers. Depending on your physique, showing off can provide a small social bonus.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790541072-530405605.png[/img]

Perishable food no longer lasts forever.

Most solid foods receive a Freshness value which slowly decreases over time.

Different foods have different expected shelf lives. Fresh fish spoils quickly, while preserves, dry ingredients, honey, grains, and similar foods can last much longer.

Refrigerators and cool storage slow future spoilage but do not magically restore food that has already aged.

Freshness is shown directly on item slots using a color-coded bar.

When food completely spoils, some or all of the stack can become [b]Moldy Food[/b]. Moldy Food cannot be eaten normally, but it can still be worked into the soil as fertilizer.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790552826-1286398258.png[/img]

Survival Valley includes a complete equipment durability system.

Supported equipment includes tools, melee weapons, fishing rods, clothing, armor, and torches.

Using equipment gradually wears it down.

Durability can be displayed directly on inventory and toolbar slots using bars or numerical percentage values.

Damaged equipment can be repaired in the field with materials or specialized repair supplies, while Clint can provide another repair option when you need professional help.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790554283-672716553.png[/img]

Different types of equipment use appropriate repair supplies.

Survival Valley includes items such as:

[list]
[*]Whetstones[/*]
[*]Farming Repair Kits[/*]
[*]Fishing Rod Repair Kits[/*]
[*]Sewing Kits[/*]
[/list]
Repair supplies have durability of their own and can wear out after repeated use.

Repairing equipment also contributes to the custom [b]Repair[/b] skill. Luck and Repair progression work together to improve your field-repair ability.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790554503-1114541559.png[/img]

Survival Valley adds nine custom progression skills:

[list]
[*]Binning[/*]
[*]Eating[/*]
[*]Excavation[/*]
[*]Luck[/*]
[*]Socializing[/*]
[*]Repair[/*]
[*]Travel[/*]
[*]Peep[/*]
[*]Pewp[/*]
[/list]
These skills improve through the activities they represent.

Travel grows from exploring on foot, Eating grows through food and cooking, Socializing improves through conversation, Repair progresses through equipment maintenance, and Peep/Pewp improve through their respective relief actions.

Skills can display floating XP progress notifications and normal level-up information.

Optional skill decay means neglected skills can slowly lose XP after long periods of inactivity, making your current lifestyle matter.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790554834-345567314.png[/img]

Survival Valley includes the Starmastery item-progression system.

Individual items and tools can gain their own Mastery levels through activities such as using, collecting, or shipping them.

A dedicated medal tab in the inventory lets you view your mastered items and their progress.

Mastery provides bonuses related to the item itself.

Depending on the item, this can include improved sale value, extra weapon damage, improved harvesting, more efficient watering, stronger food or drink effects, improved repair-tool efficiency, and other item-specific benefits.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[size=5][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790555579-45320288.png[/img][/b][/size]

The integrated Pathfinder system allows the world to visually react to repeated travel.

Tiles that are repeatedly walked across can gradually develop worn natural trails, making frequently traveled routes emerge organically over time.

Unused trails can slowly recover.

Optional settings can also account for horse and NPC traffic, while wooden paths can accumulate wear of their own.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[size=5][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790556054-255154163.png[/img][/b][/size]

Decorating your home can now have a social benefit.

Starbling calculates the value of placed furniture and decorations around your home and property.

Every 1,000g of qualifying decoration value can provide additional Friendship XP when completing your daily conversation with an NPC.

As your home becomes increasingly valuable, decorative sparkle effects can also begin appearing around your farmer.

Optional community-witness bonuses can reward nearby NPCs for seeing you socialize as well.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790556314-1330931484.png[/img]

Poor survival choices can occasionally lead to additional conditions.

Drinking unsafe water can cause Sickness, while poor dietary habits may contribute to Constipation and other digestive problems.

Medicine, Laxatives, toilets, showers, food choices, and other Survival Valley mechanics provide ways to manage these conditions.

These systems are tied into the same food, bathroom, hygiene, and health mechanics rather than existing as isolated debuffs.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790556580-1976636764.png[/img]

Survival does not completely stop when your farmer goes to bed.

Sleeping consumes Calories and Water to represent the hours spent overnight. Increasing the Eating skill reduces this overnight survival drain.

Survival Valley also removes the normal forced 2:00 AM pass-out behavior, allowing you to continue into the early morning.

However, working between late evening and early morning is physically demanding and increases Energy costs, so staying awake comes with its own downside.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790557244-1746079481.png[/img]

Survival Valley attempts to automatically understand edible items added by other Stardew Valley content mods.

When custom nutrition information is not available, the mod estimates calories, nutrition, freshness behavior, and whether an item should be treated as food or drink based on its Stardew data and context tags.

This allows a large number of modded foods to participate in Survival Valley without requiring individual compatibility patches.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790531087-1994469221.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50535/50535-1790558630-1169018550.png[/img]

Survival Valley is intentionally modular.

Generic Mod Config Menu provides controls for many individual systems, including:

[list]
[*]Hunger and calorie drain[/*]
[*]Water drain[/*]
[*]Early-game survival assistance[/*]
[*]Starvation and dehydration penalties[/*]
[*]Running and Energy drain[/*]
[*]Item weight and carry limits[/*]
[*]Stinky buildup[/*]
[*]Temperature[/*]
[*]Swimming[/*]
[*]Nutrition[/*]
[*]Muscle[/*]
[*]Pee and Poo[/*]
[*]Food freshness[/*]
[*]UV exposure[/*]
[*]Survival Skills[/*]
[*]Starmastery[/*]
[*]Durability[/*]
[*]HUD position and scale[/*]
[*]Buff icon size and layout[/*]
[/list]
You do not have to play with every feature enabled.

Want a harsher survival game? Turn the penalties up.

Want Stardew Valley with just weight, durability, swimming, and food spoilage? Disable everything else.

Survival Valley is designed to let you build the version of survival Stardew Valley that you want to play.


[center][size=5][b]STAY FED. STAY HYDRATED. STAY CLEAN. SURVIVE THE VALLEY.[/b][/size][/center]
